question: I renewed my passport. Can I still fly to Canada using the eTA linked to my old passport?
generated_answer:
When you renew your passport, the Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA) linked to your old passport is no longer valid. This is because the eTA is electronically linked to the passport number, and when you get a new passport, the old passport number is no longer valid.

To fly to Canada, you'll need to get a new eTA linked to your new passport. You can apply for a new eTA online through the Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) website. The process is relatively quick and easy, and you'll typically receive your new eTA via email within a few minutes.

Make sure to apply for the new eTA before your trip to Canada, as you won't be able to board your flight without a valid eTA linked to your new passport.

It's also a good idea to check with your airline to confirm their specific requirements and procedures for traveling to Canada with a new passport and eTA.
